verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents its own GraphQL Developer API with queries, mutations and schema introspection, plus an admin API playground and named API areas (Framework Health & Vendor Data, custom-integration push APIs). Nothing in the evidence shows that the API covers everything the UI does. Most documented workflows, such as AI systems, findings, questionnaires and access reviews, appear only as dashboard actions. Missing for 10: any statement or mapping of UI-to-API parity, documented API coverage for core UI workflows (policies, risks, audits, tasks, AI governance), a downloadable schema artifact, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Introspection allows the API to describe its schema, including available queries, mutations, and response types.
You can use the playground to explore the API schema, test queries and mutations, and validate responses in real time.
